args.message: Upgrade fastjson to 2.9.4 to fix CVE-2026-31337 (high severity, unbounded recursion in deeply nested arrays)

args.body:
## Summary
Upgrades `fastjson` from 2.8.0 → 2.9.4 to remediate CVE-2026-31337 (high severity: unbounded recursion when parsing deeply nested arrays; affects <2.9.4 and >=3.0.0 <3.1.0; fixed in 2.9.4).

## Change
- `requirements.txt`: `fastjson==2.8.0` → `fastjson==2.9.4`

## Validation
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit c8b8ab7878: passed.

Review requested from @alex (code owner approval needed to merge into protected main).
